platform.description: Platform where the publication is made (e.g., instagram, facebook)

account_id.description: Identifier of the account on the platform

meta_post_id.description: Identifier of the post on Meta platform, if applicable

asset_ref.description: Reference to the asset used in the publication

published_at_utc.description: Timestamp when the publication was published (UTC)

format.description: Format of the publication (e.g., video, image, carousel)

character.description: Character or persona used in the publication

experiment_id.description: Identifier of the experiment this publication belongs to

hypothesis_id.description: Identifier of the hypothesis being tested

account_total.description: Total revenue in the account (not attributed to any specific post)

post_attributed_revenue.description: Revenue attributed to this specific post

revenue_amount.description: Amount of revenue (if known, e.g., from user report)

currency.description: Currency of the revenue amount (e.g., USD, EUR)

window.description: Time window for the revenue (e.g., lifetime, 24h)

source.description: Source of the revenue data (e.g., user_reported, meta_reported)

role.description: Role of the publication in the experiment (test or control)
